categories.name: Political Science & International Relations
categories.description: Political science, political studies, and international relations programs covering Canadian government, comparative politics, political theory, and global affairs, along with applied public affairs and policy degrees.

tips.title: Join Model UN
tips.detail: Model United Nations conferences build the research, public-speaking, and negotiation skills these programs reward, and sustained involvement — chairing a committee or leading a delegation — is concrete evidence of interest in politics and international affairs.

tips.title: Compete on a debate team
tips.detail: Debate club sharpens argumentation and current-affairs knowledge, and results at regional or provincial tournaments give admissions and scholarship committees a clear signal beyond course grades.

tips.title: Volunteer on a campaign or in a constituency office
tips.detail: Volunteering for a political campaign or in an MP or MPP constituency office shows first-hand engagement with how government actually works and produces specific stories to draw on in supplementary applications and scholarship essays.

Listed prerequisites are Ontario 4U equivalents; other provinces' equivalents are accepted.

supplementary.name: Personal Profile
supplementary.description: Short written responses about experiences, activities, and what you learned from them; weighted alongside grades for all direct-entry UBC applicants.

tips.title: Take the Personal Profile seriously
tips.detail: The Personal Profile is weighted alongside your marks. Draft your short answers early, be specific about what you did and what it taught you, and have someone you trust review them before submitting.

tips.title: UBC application deadline
tips.detail: Apply through EducationPlannerBC by January 15, 2027 for September 2027 entry. Verify the current cycle's dates on UBC's admissions site before relying on them.

tips.title: Major entrance awards are profile-based
tips.detail: UBC's major entrance awards, including Presidential Scholars Awards, are selected from the application and Personal Profile rather than an automatic average cutoff; some require a separate application.

programs.notes: Admission is to UBC's Bachelor of Arts, with majors declared after first year. International Relations at UBC is an upper-year program entered from within the BA rather than directly from high school, so applicants interested in IR apply to Arts and typically begin in Political Science.
